description: Submission of the Revenue Protection Order made under the provisions of the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-02-23 to implement four customs import duty bands of 0%, 10%, 20%, and 30%, replacing the previously existed three-band structure, with the objective of promoting targeted growth in the country's export earnings, to implement the recommendations of the National Tariff Policy Committee and to implement New National Sub Divisions of HS Codes to support the development of the domestic agriculture and industrial sectors. The Revenue Protection                                   Order - No.01/2026 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2478/03 dated 2026-03-03, under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 laying down provisions for the aforesaid purpose. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Revenue Protection Order to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
